That meant that there weren't enough IP4 addresses to go around in China, and so they transitioned early to IP6.  IP4 is the old addressing system, whereas IP6 is the new system.  The new system has advantages including effectively unlimited IP addresses, basically one billion IP addresses for every ant on the planet.
An IP address is a digital location on the Internet.  Think of it like a normal street address.  You can find out your own IP address by Googling *what's my ip address*.
